DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの用紙についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: A question about the form you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この説明会の案内が届きました。参加できない場合も返事が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明会に参加できなくても返信が必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This briefing invitation arrived. Do I need to reply even if I can't attend?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to reply despite being unable to attend the briefing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出欠の回答欄がありますね。この案内では欠席の場合も回答するよう書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's an attendance-response section. This notice says to reply even if absent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事で行けないので欠席に丸を付けます。理由も書く欄がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仕事で欠席すると伝え、理由を書く欄を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can't go because of work, so I'll circle Absent. Is there a place for the reason?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will be absent for work and ask where to write the reason. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 理由を書く欄はありません。下のお名前と住所の欄もお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: No reason section. Write your name and address below too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返信の締切は十五日ですが、郵便が十五日に着く必要があるんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十五日が返信の到着期限か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The reply deadline is the fifteenth; must the post arrive on the fifteenth?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm whether the fifteenth is the arrival deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここには十五日必着とあります。郵送が間に合わない場合の提出先は、主催の担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: It says must arrive by the fifteenth. If post won't make it, let's ask the organizer where to submit it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は十三日です。今ここで担当の窓口に渡せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の日付を伝え、担当窓口に直接提出できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today is the thirteenth. Can I hand it directly to the responsible counter here now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give today's date and ask about submitting directly to the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 主催は二階の地域担当です。提出を受け付けてもらえるか、内線でおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The organizer is the community department upstairs on the second floor. I'll connect internally to ask whether they'll accept it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今日提出できるか、担当の方に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の提出可否を主催担当へ聞くため電話の接続を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'd like to ask the officer whether I can submit today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the phone connection to ask the organizer about submitting today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当につなぎますので、どうぞこちらの電話をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll connect you; please use this phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first consultation here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、初めてです。昨日の夜からのどが痛く、今日は熱もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初診であることと、昨夜からのどが痛く今日は発熱したことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, this is my first visit. My throat has hurt since last night and I have a fever today too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say this is your first visit, your throat hurt since last night, and fever started today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状を看護師に伝えます。こちらの問診票と、保険の資格を確認できるものをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell the nurse your symptoms. Please complete this questionnaire and provide proof of insurance eligibility.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらを出します。問診票の『服用中の薬』には、市販の薬も書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保険の確認書類を出し、市販薬も服用欄に書くか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the document. For Medicines currently taken, should I include over-the-counter medicines?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Provide insurance verification and ask whether to list OTC medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、市販の薬もご記入ください。名前がわかる箱などはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, include those too. Have you a box or something showing its name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨夜飲んだ薬の箱を持っていますが、薬の名前をうまく書けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬の箱はあるが名前を記入しにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought last night's medicine box, but I have difficulty writing the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the medicine box but cannot easily enter the name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱を看護師に見せられるよう、お手元に置いてください。名前の欄には『箱を持参』と書いていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep the box to show the nurse. In the name section you may write Brought the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。次の診察までに、その薬をもう一度飲んでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記入方法を受け入れ、診察前に薬を再び飲めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. May I take that medicine again before the upcoming consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the entry method and ask about taking the medicine again before consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 飲むかどうかは受付では判断できません。看護師にそのご質問も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Reception can't decide whether to take it. I'll pass that question to the nurse too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、飲まずに看護師の方へ質問します。問診票はこちらに出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 服薬の質問を看護師にすると決め、問診票を提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I won't take it yet and will ask the nurse. I'll hand in the questionnaire here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to ask the nurse about medicine and submit the questionnaire. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。看護師がお呼びしますので、どうぞ奥の待合へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take it. The nurse will call you; please go to the waiting area inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご用件でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅へ向かう途中で定期入れを拾いました。こちらに届けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅へ向かう途中で拾った定期入れを届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a commuter-pass holder on my way to the station. I'd like to hand it in here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hand in the pass holder found en route to the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お預かりします。拾った場所と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll take it. Where and when did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝八時ごろ、商店街の出口の横断歩道の手前です。地図で示してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝八時ごろの発見と横断歩道手前の場所を説明し、地図の使用を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around eight this morning, before the crossing at the shopping street's exit. May I show you on a map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the eight o'clock finding and location before the crossing, and ask to use a map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この地図をお使いください。道路のどちら側でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, this map. Which side of the road?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このパン屋がある側です。歩道の端に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パン屋側の歩道の端に落ちていたと地図で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The side with this bakery. It was at the pavement's edge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show on the map the edge of the pavement on the bakery side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらですね。連絡のため、お名前と電話番号をこの欄にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here, right. Write your name and phone number in this section for contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話は昼間出られないことがあります。夕方五時以降に連絡していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昼の電話に出にくいと伝え、五時以降の連絡を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I sometimes can't answer during the day. Could you contact me after five in the evening?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say daytime calls are difficult and request contact after five. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望を記録します。こちらが届け出の控えです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record the preference. Here's your report copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この控えについて問い合わせるときは、ここにある番号を伝えればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問い合わせ時に控えの受付番号を伝えるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. When inquiring about this copy, do I give the number here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm giving the reception number on your copy for inquiries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その受付番号をお伝えください。お届けいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, give that reference number. Thank you for handing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は何のお手続きですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この転居届を出したいです。旧住所の部屋番号を書き忘れたので、先に直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居届を提出したいと伝え、旧住所の部屋番号漏れを直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to submit this change-of-address notice. I forgot the room number in the old address and want to correct it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to submit a move notice and correct the missing old room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ受け付けていませんので、この旧住所の欄にお書きください。何号室でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We haven't accepted it yet; add it in the old-address section. What room was it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二〇三号室でした。番地の後ろに『二〇三号室』と書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧住所が二〇三号室だったと伝え、追記位置を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Room 203. Should I write Room 203 after the street number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the old room number 203 and ask where to add it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この空いている所へお願いします。転居する方のお名前も確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, in this blank space. Let me check the names of those moving too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 転居するのは私一人です。ほかの家族は旧住所に残ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分だけが転居し、家族は旧住所に残ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only me. The other family members remain at the old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain only you are moving and family remain at the old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、転居する方の欄はご本人だけですね。住所とお名前を確認できる書類をお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then only your name in the moving-persons section. Provide a document verifying your address and name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。書いた名前に間違いがないか、一緒に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認書類を出し、名前の記入を見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here. Could we check together that the name I wrote is correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Provide verification and ask to check the written name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、書類と同じ表記になっています。訂正した部屋番号も読めますので、この届をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, it matches the document. The corrected room number is legible too, so I'll take this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。提出する前に直せてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正済みの転居届の受付を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'm glad I could correct it before submitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request acceptance of the corrected move notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お手続きありがとうございます。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for completing the procedure. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はどのようなご用件ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯の番号を変えたので、口座の連絡先を直したいです。通帳と本人確認書類を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯番号の登録変更を頼み、通帳と本人確認書類を持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mobile number changed, so I'd like to update my account's contact information. I've brought my passbook and ID.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request registered mobile-number change and say you brought passbook and ID. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拝見します。こちらの変更用紙に新しい番号をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see them. Write the new number on this change form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい番号はここですね。前の番号はもう使えませんが、そちらにも連絡が行きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新番号の記入場所を確認し、使えない旧番号への連絡を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The new number goes here, right? The old one no longer works; will you contact it too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm where to enter the new number and ask about contact to the unusable old one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この手続きについて旧番号へ電話はしません。変更の確認書は、登録されている住所へ郵送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We won't phone the old number about this procedure. We'll post confirmation to your registered address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所は変わっていません。新しい番号にショートメールで確認が届くわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所が同じだと伝え、確認が郵送であることを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The address hasn't changed. So it won't be an SMS confirmation to the new number, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the address is unchanged and confirm postal verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、今回は郵送の確認書です。入力した番号を読み上げますので、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, a mailed confirmation this time. I'll read back the entered number; check it, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 読み上げた番号で合っています。もし確認書の番号が違っていたら、どこへ電話すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読み上げた番号を確認し、確認書に誤りがあった場合の連絡先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number you read is correct. If it's wrong on the letter, where should I phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the readback and ask whom to contact if the letter contains an error. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認書に記載の支店の番号へお願いします。こちらにも同じ番号を書いてお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Phone the branch number on the letter. I'll write the same number here for you too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。確認書が届いたら番号を見て、違っていたら支店に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届いた確認書の番号を見て、誤りは支店へ連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. When the letter arrives I'll check the number, and contact the branch if wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the mailed number and report errors to the branch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お手続きありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Thank you for completing the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ジャムをお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、一人で食べるので少しだけ欲しいです。この大きい瓶と小さい瓶は同じ味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人分のジャムを探していると伝え、大小の瓶の味を比べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, only a little for myself. Are this big jar and small jar the same flavor?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you're looking for jam for one and compare flavors in large and small jars. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらもいちごですが、小さい瓶は砂糖を控えた商品です。原材料はこちらに書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Both strawberry, but the small jar has reduced sugar. Ingredients are written here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい瓶のほうがよさそうです。開けた後は冷蔵庫に入れるんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小瓶に関心を示し、開封後の冷蔵保存を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The small jar looks better. Does it go in the refrigerator after opening?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show interest in the small jar and ask about refrigerating after opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この瓶には『開封後は冷蔵』と書いてあります。ふたを閉めて冷蔵庫に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It says refrigerate after opening. Close the lid and put it in the fridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 横に書いてある『お早めに』は、何日以内という意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 『お早めに』が具体的な日数を表すか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Does use soon on the side mean within a certain number of days?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether use soon specifies a number of days. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この表示には日数は書かれていません。詳しい目安は、ここにあるメーカーの連絡先で尋ねていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: No number is given on this label. You can ask the manufacturer at this contact for detailed guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日数は決まって書かれていないんですね。小さい瓶はいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日数が表示されていないと確認し、小瓶の価格を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: So no fixed number is written. How much is the small jar?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm no days are specified and ask the small-jar price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二百九十八円です。百五十グラム入りです。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それなら小さい瓶を一つ買います。開けたら冷蔵庫で保存します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小瓶を一つ買い、開封後は冷蔵すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll buy one small jar. After opening I'll store it in the fridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy one small jar and say you'll refrigerate after opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お会計は前方のレジでどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please pay at the checkout ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 池の東側は工事で通れません。散歩でしたら、こちらの案内図をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The pond's east side is closed for construction. For walks, look at this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池を一周したかったんですが、反対側からなら回れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 池の反対側から一周できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd hoped to walk around the pond; can I loop around from the opposite side?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can circle the pond from the other side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は池を一周できません。西側のベンチまで行って、同じ道を戻る形になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can't circle it today. Go to the west-side bench and return on the same path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 往復でどのくらいかかりますか。二十分ほど歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二十分歩きたいと伝え、ベンチまでの往復時間を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: How long round trip? I'd like about twenty minutes' walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want twenty minutes and ask the bench round-trip time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ゆっくり歩いて往復十五分ほどです。ベンチで休む時間を入れると二十分くらいになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: About fifteen minutes walking slowly. With a bench rest, around twenty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それならベンチまで行きます。途中に階段はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチまで行くと決め、階段の有無を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll go to the bench. Any stairs along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the bench and ask about stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 西側の道には階段はありません。池に沿って進み、赤い柵の手前のベンチで折り返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: No stairs on the west path. Follow the pond and turn at the bench before the red fence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 赤い柵の先が工事中なんですね。帰りもこの入口に戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 工事境界を確認し、同じ入口へ戻れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Construction is beyond the red fence, then. Can I return to this same entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the construction boundary and ask about returning to the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、来た道を戻ればこの入口です。入口の時計を目印にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, back the same way. Use the entrance clock as your landmark.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時計のある入口ですね。ベンチで休んで、同じ道を戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時計を入口の目印として確認し、ベンチで休んで引き返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The entrance with the clock. I'll rest at the bench and return by the same path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the entrance clock and say you'll rest at the bench then return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、どうぞ散歩をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どうされましたか。改札口でお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: What happened? Trouble at the gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今降りた列車に傘を忘れました。まだ改札は出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車に傘を忘れ、まだ改札内にいると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my umbrella on the train I just got off. I haven't left the gates yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you left an umbrella on the train and are still inside the gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの列車でしょうか。到着した時刻を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which train? Do you remember its arrival time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時二十分に着いた列車です。先頭の車両に乗っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車の到着時刻と乗った車両を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The 10:20 arrival. I was in the first carriage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give arrival time and carriage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 傘の色と、置いた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell me the umbrella color and where you put it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紺色の長い傘です。進行方向の右側の座席の下に置きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紺色の長傘と座席下の位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: A long navy umbrella. I put it under the seat on the right in the direction of travel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the navy long umbrella and under-seat location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その内容で捜索を依頼します。見つかったときの連絡先を、こちらにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll request a search using that. Your contact details here for when it's found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話番号を書きました。今日は夕方まで、この近くにいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話番号を記入し、夕方まで近くにいると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written the phone number. I'll be around here until this evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Enter the phone number and say you'll be nearby until evening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、この連絡票をお持ちください。問い合わせる際は、右上の番号をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Take this contact slip. For inquiries, give the number at the top right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右上の番号ですね。見つかったら、受け取る場所も電話で教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問い合わせ番号を確認し、発見時に受取場所も知らせるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Top right, yes. If found, could you also tell me by phone where to collect it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm inquiry number and request the collection place when found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、見つかったときに受取場所もお伝えします。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we'll tell you the collection place when found. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入届の記入で、わからないところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Any questions filling in the moving-in form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 建物名が長くて、この欄に入りません。途中まで書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建物名が欄に収まらず途中まで記入したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The building name is too long for this section. I've already written part of it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the building name doesn't fit and you have written part. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今書いた部分はそのままで結構です。続きはこちらの余白に書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Leave what you've written. Continue in this blank space.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この右側の余白ですね。部屋番号も続けて書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 続きの余白を確認し、部屋番号も書くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The blank on the right. Do I add the room number too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the continuation space and ask about room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、建物名の後に部屋番号を書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, write the room number after the building name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書きました。住所の数字は、この契約書と同じでよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記入を済ませ、住所の数字を契約書に合わせてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Done. Are the address numbers as in this contract all right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Finish writing and ask whether to match the contract's address numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 契約書の住所を見ながら書かれたのですね。番地の数字を一つずつ読み合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You've copied the contract address. Let's read each street-number digit together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三丁目十二番八号、二〇五号室です。用紙にも同じように書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番地と部屋番号を読み、用紙にも同じ内容を書いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: 3-chome, 12-8, Room 205. I've written the same on the form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the street and room numbers and say they match the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 数字は一致しています。日付と署名も記入して、向こうの受付にお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The numbers match. Add date and signature and submit to reception over there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の日付と署名を書きました。この契約書は自分で持っていてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付と署名を記入し、契約書を持っていてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written today's date and signature. May I keep the contract myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Enter date and signature and ask to retain the contract. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お手元にお持ちください。届出は向こうの受付へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, keep it. Submit the notice at reception over there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察は終わりましたね。次回の予約票をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your consultation is finished. Here's your next appointment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。先生とは火曜日の九時半と話しましたが、これで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 医師と話した火曜日九時半の予約と一致するか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. We discussed Tuesday at 9:30 with the doctor; does this match?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm the appointment matches Tuesday 9:30 agreed with the doctor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約表も火曜日の九時半です。こちらの紙にも同じ日時が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The appointment schedule is Tuesday 9:30 too. This paper gives the same date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 九時半は、受付に来る時刻ですか。それとも診察の予約時刻ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 九時半が受付時刻か診察予約時刻か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is 9:30 when I come to reception or the consultation appointment time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether 9:30 is reception or consultation time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診察の予約時刻です。この案内では、受付は十五分前からとなっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The consultation time. These instructions say reception starts fifteen minutes earlier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では九時十五分に受付へ来ます。今度もこの外来でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付には九時十五分に来ると伝え、同じ外来か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll come to reception at 9:15. Is it this outpatient department again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll arrive at reception at 9:15 and confirm the same outpatient department. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、同じ外来です。先に一階の受付を済ませてから、こちらへお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, same department. Finish ground-floor reception first, then come here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一階で受付をしてから、ここに来るのですね。予約票も持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一階の受付後に外来へ来る順序を確認し、予約票を持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ground-floor reception, then here. I'll bring the appointment slip too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm reception then outpatient sequence and bringing the slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。診察券もお忘れなく。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Don't forget your patient card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 診察券とこの予約票を、同じ袋に入れておきます。案内をありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察券と予約票を一緒に保管すると伝えて礼を言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put the card and this appointment slip in the same bag. Thank you for the guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll keep card and slip together and thank them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお持ち帰りください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take it home. Have a safe trip home.
